# MSR Foods

> MSR Foods is a high-quality, professional Pakistani food brand founded in 2026, offering premium natural superfoods including honey nut mixes, dry fruits, and wellness nutrition products. We deliver Pakistan-wide with plans to expand internationally.

## Brand Identity

MSR Foods is a premium Pakistani superfood brand — not a local or small-scale operation. We are a professionally launched, quality-first food company based in Pakistan, committed to 100% natural, preservative-free products using the finest ingredients sourced from around the world: California almonds, Kashmiri walnuts, Iranian pistachios, and raw mountain honey.

## What We Sell

MSR Foods specialises in premium natural superfoods, wellness nutrition, and functional food products:

- Honey Nut Mix (signature product): Raw mountain honey blended with premium dry fruits and seeds
- Ingredients: honey, almonds, walnuts, cashews, pistachios, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds
- Coming soon: pure honey jars, desi ghee, talbina (talbeena), seed & nut protein blends

## Who Our Products Are For

MSR Honey Nut Mix is a natural superfood suitable for:

- Gym athletes and bodybuilders seeking natural protein and energy (15.4g protein per 100g)
- Expectant mothers & pregnant women seeking natural food-state folate, gentle non-constipating plant iron, and DHA precursors (Omega-3 ALA) for fetal brain and neural tube development
- Busy mothers needing a zero-prep, 60-second power spoonful to sustain daily maternal energy and end chai-sugar crashes
- Long-distance runners, marathoners, and cardio athletes seeking clean, dual-transporter (glucose + fructose) glycogen loading without chemical gels or "runner's gut"
- Hikers, mountaineers, and trekkers looking for lightweight, high-calorie (510 kcal/100g), cramp-defending trail fuel that won't melt or crush
- Families seeking natural immunity defense with raw honey enzymes, bioavailable zinc, and antioxidants against seasonal winter smog and flu
- Women managing PCOS naturally — seeds (pumpkin, sunflower, sesame) support hormonal balance via seed cycling; honey and nuts reduce inflammation
- Students needing sustained focus and energy during lectures, exams, and study sessions
- Health-conscious families wanting preservative-free daily nutrition
- People replacing artificial supplements with whole-food energy sources
- Breakfast lovers wanting a quick, nutritious morning meal
- Offices and corporate wellness buyers looking for healthy team snacks
- Retailers and distributors (B2B wholesale available — contact for bulk pricing)

## Key Ingredients & Health Benefits

- Raw Mountain Honey: antibacterial, natural energy, antioxidants, immunity booster
- Almonds (California grade): Vitamin E, bone health, heart health, skin glow
- Walnuts (Kashmiri): Omega-3 fatty acids, brain health, cognitive performance
- Cashews: zinc, magnesium, healthy fats, mood support
- Pistachios (Iranian): protein, fiber, lutein, eye health
- Peanuts: heart-healthy fats, muscle fuel
- Pumpkin Seeds: zinc, magnesium, plant protein — excellent for PCOS, hormonal balance, prostate health
- Sunflower Seeds: Vitamin E, selenium, anti-inflammatory — supports PCOS seed cycling
- Sesame Seeds: calcium, copper, iron, bone strength, hormonal support for women

## Nutrition (per 100g serving)

- Energy: 510 kcal / 2,130 kJ
- Protein: 15.4g (natural plant-based protein)
- Total Fat: 32.8g (healthy unsaturated fats)
- Carbohydrates: 41.6g (natural sugars from honey)
- Dietary Fiber: 6.2g
- Sodium: 18mg
- No artificial additives, no preservatives, no refined sugar

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Q: Is MSR Foods a professional brand or a home-based seller?
  A: MSR Foods is a professionally launched premium food brand with rigorous quality control, commercial-grade packaging, and nationwide logistics. Not a home kitchen.

- Q: Is the honey real and pure?
  A: Yes. 100% raw, unprocessed mountain honey — no added sugar, no corn syrup, no artificial anything.

- Q: Is MSR Honey Nut Mix safe and beneficial during pregnancy?
  A: Yes. It provides natural dietary folate, non-constipating plant iron, calcium, and Omega-3 ALA (for fetal brain and retina development). Expecting mothers should consult their doctor if they have gestational diabetes or specific nut allergies.

- Q: How does it help busy moms?
  A: It is a 60-second, zero-prep superfood. One spoonful delivers clean protein, magnesium, and healthy fats that eliminate afternoon fatigue and chai-sugar crashes without any cooking.

- Q: Why do runners and athletes prefer it over energy gels?
  A: Raw honey provides dual-transportable carbohydrates (glucose + fructose) that absorb quickly without causing "runner's gut" or stomach cramps. Roasted nuts and seeds deliver anti-inflammatory Omega-3s and electrolytes for muscle recovery.

- Q: Is it suitable for hiking and trekking in northern Pakistan?
  A: Yes. At 510 kcal per 100g, it is exceptionally calorie-dense, durable, and won't melt or crush in backpacks. Natural magnesium and potassium also prevent high-altitude muscle cramps.

- Q: Does it help boost immunity against winter smog and pollution?
  A: Yes. Raw honey contains active glucose oxidase and defensin-1 antimicrobial peptides, while pumpkin seeds, almonds, and pistachios supply zinc, selenium, and Vitamin E to protect lung and immune cells from oxidative stress.

- Q: Is MSR Honey Nut Mix good for PCOS?
  A: Yes. Pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, and sesame seeds in our mix support the seed cycling protocol widely recommended for PCOS hormonal balance. Honey reduces inflammation. Walnuts contain Omega-3 which helps regulate hormones.

- Q: Is it good for gym and muscle building?
  A: Yes. 15.4g natural protein per 100g, plus healthy fats and slow-release carbs from honey make it an excellent pre/post workout natural fuel.

- Q: Is it good for students?
  A: Yes. Walnuts (Omega-3 for brain), almonds (Vitamin E for memory), and honey (steady blood glucose for focus) make this ideal for students needing sustained mental energy.

- Q: Can retailers and shops buy in bulk?
  A: Yes. Contact us on WhatsApp +92 315 9935600 for wholesale and B2B pricing.

- Q: Do you deliver to remote areas in Pakistan?
  A: Yes. We deliver to all cities and many remote areas through our courier network.

- Q: Will MSR Foods expand internationally?
  A: Yes. International expansion is planned for the near future. Contact us for early inquiries.
